docs.title: Core Person Vocabulary
docs.text:
LinkML approximation of the SEMIC Core Person Vocabulary 2.1.1. The Core Person Vocabulary captures the fundamental characteristics of a person, e.g. name, gender, date of birth, etc. It is the ontological backbone for several Core Vocabularies and Application Profiles published by SEMIC.

URI: https://semiceu.github.io/Core-Person-Vocabulary/releases/2.1.1

Name: core_person

docs.title: GYear
docs.text:
search: boost: 1.0 ---# Type: GYear

An XSD gregorian year (e.g. "1980"). Represents a year value in the proleptic Gregorian calendar without a month or day. Backed by Python str because Python has no native gYear type.

docs.title: GYearMonth
docs.text:
search: boost: 1.0 ---# Type: GYearMonth

An XSD gregorian year-month (e.g. "1980-09"). Represents a specific month of a specific year in the proleptic Gregorian calendar without a day. Backed by Python str because Python has no native gYearMonth type.

docs.title: Slot: address area (addressArea)
docs.text: The name of a geographic area that groups Addresses.

docs.title: Slot: administrative unit level 1 (administrativeUnitLevel1)
docs.text: The name of the uppermost level of the address, almost always a country.

docs.title: Slot: administrative unit level 2 (administrativeUnitLevel2)
docs.text: The name of a secondary level/region of the address, usually a county, state or other such area that typically encompasses several localities.

docs.title: Slot: name (agentName)
docs.text: The noun given to the Agent.

docs.title: Slot: type (agentType)
docs.text: A classification assigned to an Agent.

docs.title: Slot: alternative name (alternativeName)
docs.text: Any name by which a Person is known, other than their full name.

docs.title: Slot: birth name (birthName)
docs.text: Full name of the Person given upon their birth.

docs.title: Slot: citizenship (citizenship)
docs.text: The Jurisdiction that has conferred citizenship rights on the Person such as the right to vote, to receive certain protection from the community or the issuance of a passport.

docs.title: Slot: contact page (contactPage)
docs.text: A web page that could be used to reach out the Contact Point.

docs.title: Slot: contact point (contactPoint)
docs.text: The main contact information of the resource.

docs.title: core_person
docs.text:
LinkML approximation of the SEMIC Core Person Vocabulary 2.1.1. The Core Person Vocabulary captures the fundamental characteristics of a person, e.g. name, gender, date of birth, etc. It is the ontological backbone for several Core Vocabularies and Application Profiles published by SEMIC.

URI: https://semiceu.github.io/Core-Person-Vocabulary/releases/2.1.1

docs.title: Slot: country of birth (countryOfBirth)
docs.text: The country in which the Person was born.

docs.title: Slot: country of death (countryOfDeath)
docs.text: The country in which the Person died.

docs.title: Slot: date of birth (dateOfBirth)
docs.text: The point in time on which the Person was born.

docs.title: Slot: date of death (dateOfDeath)
docs.text: The point in time on which the Person died.

docs.title: Slot: date of issue (dateOfIssue)
docs.text: The date on which the Identifier was assigned.

docs.title: Slot: domicile (domicile)
docs.text: The place that the Person treats as permanent home.

docs.title: Slot: family name (familyName)
docs.text: The hereditary surname of a family.

docs.title: Slot: full address (fullAddress)
docs.text: The complete address written as a string.

docs.title: Slot: full name (fullName)
docs.text: The complete name of the Person as one string.

docs.title: Slot: gender (gender)
docs.text: The identities, expressions and societal roles of the Person.

docs.title: Slot: geographic identifier (geographicIdentifier)
docs.text: A reference in the form of a Uniform Resource Identifier to the Location.

docs.title: Slot: geographic name (geographicName)
docs.text: A textual description for a Location.

docs.title: Slot: given name (givenName)
docs.text: The name(s) that identify the Person within a family with a common surname.

docs.title: Slot: has email (hasEmail)
docs.text: An electronic address through which the Contact Point can be contacted.

docs.title: Slot: has telephone (hasTelephone)
docs.text: A telephone number through which the Contact Point can be contacted.

docs.title: Slot: identifier (identifier)
docs.text: The unambiguous structured reference to the Person.

docs.title: Slot: identifies (identifies)
docs.text: The entity that is referenced by the Identifier.

docs.title: Slot: issuing authority URI (issuingAuthorityUri)
docs.text: The reference in the form of a Uniform Resource Identifier to the issuing authority.

docs.title: Slot: id (jurisdictionId)
docs.text: A reference in the form of a Uniform Resource Identifier to the Jurisdiction.

docs.title: Slot: name (jurisdictionName)
docs.text: A string of characters that represents a Jurisdiction.

docs.title: Slot: locator name (locatorName)
docs.text: Proper noun(s) applied to the real world entity identified by the locator. The locator name could be the name of the property or complex, of the building or part of the building, or it could be the name of a room inside a building.

docs.title: Slot: matronymic name (matronymicName)
docs.text: Name based on the given name of the Person's mother.

docs.title: Slot: patronymic name (patronymicName)
docs.text: Name based on the given name of the Person's father.

docs.title: Slot: place of birth (placeOfBirth)
docs.text: The Location where the Person was born.

docs.title: Slot: place of death (placeOfDeath)
docs.text: The Location where the Person died.

docs.title: Slot: post name (postName)
docs.text: A name created and maintained for postal purposes to identify a subdivision of addresses and postal delivery points.

docs.title: Slot: residency (residency)
docs.text: Jurisdiction where the Person has their dwelling.

docs.title: Slot: scheme name (schemeName)
docs.text: Name of the scheme used to construct the identifier.

docs.title: Slot: scheme URI (schemeUri)
docs.text: URI of the scheme used to construct the identifier.

docs.title: Slot: sex (sex)
docs.text: The organism's biological sex.

docs.title: Slot: thoroughfare (thoroughfare)
docs.text: The name of a passage or way through from one location to another.
